title: 通过逐定理符号验证器生成反例：模仿有害而强化修复
summary: 该研究将反例生成建模为针对确定性逐定理Python验证器的约束见证生成，发布SymCE语料库（4707个假猜想及可执行验证器），验证器同时作为奖励函数。实验发现仅用反例SFT会导致真定理识别率从0.27崩溃至0.00（模仿陷阱），而稀疏结果奖励的RLVR可修复并提升至0.66。4B模型超越所有7B开源数学专家模型，与六个前沿商业API竞争。
summary_en: This work frames counterexample generation as constrained witness emission against deterministic per-theorem Python verifiers, releasing SymCE (4,707 false conjectures with executable verifiers) that doubles as a reward function. Counterexample-only SFT causes an imitation trap (true-theorem recognition collapses from 0.27 to 0.00), while sparse-reward RLVR repairs it to 0.66. The 4B model outperforms all evaluated 7B open-weights math specialists and rivals six frontier commercial APIs.
